policies.name: Two gates
policies.desc: Gate 1 decides whether an artifact EXISTS for a viewer (audience). Gate 2 decides which ROWS a viewer sees inside it (data scope). They are administered separately.

policies.name: Counts are computed
policies.desc: Every count on this screen — "sees 19 of 38" — is derived from the project roster at paint time, never typed.

policies.name: Rule shape
policies.desc: A person is full-scope, or restricted by exactly one basis field plus optional masks.

policies.name: Legal basis
policies.desc: A field qualifies as a restriction basis only if every one of its values is known on every row (project, category, depot, contract, funding source).

policies.name: Authority view
policies.desc: An authority reader sees project costs, approved scope and delivery evidence; operator margin and GER provision stay restricted.

policies.name: Correspondence is runtime
policies.desc: Mailbox content is read at question time under the reader's permissions and never becomes a graph fact or a cached figure.

policies.name: Contract exit
policies.desc: Deletion and handback at contract end apply to originals, extracts, indexes, cached answers and derived datasets.
